remarks: This spacious, updated 2-bedroom condo in the desirable Nor-West community is now available for rent! With heat and hot water included, this home offers exceptional value and comfort.  Start your day with coffee or relax with a drink on the generous balcony overlooking a serene grassy courtyard. The unit boasts modern upgrades, including granite countertops, recessed lighting, bamboo hardwood flooring, crown molding, and a built-in closet in the second bedroom. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry with a new washer and two new wall-mounted A/C units for year-round comfort.  The Nor-West community provides fantastic amenities, such as a pool, clubhouse, and playground, for residents to enjoy. Parking is effortless with one assigned spot directly in front of the unit, visitor spaces for guests, and additional spots available. An oversized storage unit is also included for your convenience.  Conveniently located on the Norwalk/Westport border, this home is within walking distance of schools, shopping, restaurants, train stations, and highways.
